item.title: Fretboard Summit, Chicago Here I Come!
item.description:
I’d been wanting to go and cover the Fretboard Summit (fretboardsummit.org) in Chicago for years. It’s a guitar event created by Jason Verlinde, editor-in-chief of the Fretboard Journal (fretboardjournal.com). It features concerts, talks, panel discussions and, of course, a guitar show. Well, 2026 will be the year this plan comes to fruition, as I’ll be in Chicago from 19 to 24 August.

As I explain in the video below, I firmly believe that when times are tough, as they are at the moment, it’s the best time to break new ground. The program for this Fretboard Summit looks brilliant and promises some wonderful encounters and fascinating reports. I can’t wait to be there.

Fretboard Summit Announcement

The Guitar Channel podcast

The audio version of the video is available in the podcast on iTunes, Spotify and below:

Until the next interview or gear review, keep on playing the guitar!

Pierre Journel.

item.title: Finland ToneFest: Petri Matero Organizer Interview
item.description:
In 2026, The Guitar Channel travelled to Finland for the first time to cover ToneFest (tonefest.fi), the country’s biggest guitar show. Here is an interview with Petri Matero, organiser of this wonderful event and owner of the shop Tonefest Guitar Gallery (tonefestguitargallery.com), also located in Tuusula, just north of Helsinki.

A big thank you to Petri, who partly funded my trip to Finland and thus made it possible

Petri Matero interview

The Guitar Channel podcast

The audio version of the video is available in the podcast on iTunes, Spotify and below:

Photo album

My take on this guitar show

I absolutely loved covering this guitar show. It was a blast to meet luthiers producing instruments of the very highest standard. The Finnish musicians who were there, whether performing in concert or giving masterclasses, were top-class; I was truly blown away by meeting all these talented people.

If the stars align, I hope to be able to go back there in the future.

Until the next interview or gear review, keep on playing the guitar!

Pierre Journel.

For more info:
ToneFest Reports

item.title: Puteaux Guitar Festival, Florent Monfort Interview
item.description:
The Puteaux Guitar Festival / Festival Guitare de Puteaux (culture.puteaux.fr) will hold its 6th edition from October 10th to 12th, 2025. It will be the first under the direction of Florent Monfort, who is now the director of the Puteaux conservatory. I work for Florent again via The Guitar Channel, as organizer of the luthier show and also to advise him on programming at his request. Here's the interview to start revealing what's going to happen in October.

Puteaux Guitar Festival
October 10th to 12th 2025

Florent Monfort interview

The Guitar Channel podcast

The audio version of the video is available in the podcast on iTunes, Spotify and below:

The Puteaux music academy: an extraordinary place dedicated to music

Puteaux music academy is a magnificent venue with a top-class concert hall seating over 600. There are also numerous spaces available for masterclasses, instrument practice and additional concert halls.

Conservatoire Jean-Baptiste Lully
5bis, rue de Pressensé – 92800 Puteaux

Guitar show

Depending on the date on which you read this article, there may still be time to apply as a guitar builder to take part in the guitar show organized by The Guitar Channel.

Click Here to Submit Your Application for the Guitar Show

Until the next interview or gear review, keep on playing the guitar!

Pierre Journel.

item.title: MIGS Academy: boost your guitar skills in Classical, Fingerstyle or Rock in Montreux
item.description:
A major innovation for Montreux International Guitar Show aka the MIGS (migs.ch) is that this 2024 edition will be preceded by a guitar workshop with top Classical, Fingerstyle and Rock musicians! This is the MIGS Academy (migs-masters-camps.com) which will take place from Monday April 22 to Friday April 26 in Montreux.

Here's an interview with organizers David Rosset and Emmanuel Cottier, accompanied by musician Vincent Schmidt, one of the coaches.

Coaches by style

  • Classique
    • Thibault Cauvin, Pierre Willimann, Monica Torti
  • Fingerstyle
    • Jon Gomm, Alexandr Misko, Vincent Schmidt, Adrien Delamarre
  • Rock

Already interviewed several times, he sent to the showroom of The Guitar Channel a Strat like no other. Indeed, not only is the inspiration clearly David Gilmour's vintage guitar #00001 but its body is made of Mahogany. On this kind of guitar
